body: Quick pass (coordinator, no build): the PR merges cleanly with main; the author's runs on the final head are green with the tests named (guide_projects::indexed_guide_preserves_legacy_basis_and_path, machines_pane::the_sheet_states_rigid_tapping_in_words, the negative pin a_legacy_first_traverse_warning_matches_only_the_same_raise, the whole camcraft-ui lib 1387 passed, clippy -p camcraft-ui clean); test files only, no shipped file changed; the follow-up for the example cache is #3234. The coordinator flags it ready for the independent review. It fixes a red main.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 338618477b618b35263f5007b659f4baf3d633e1 -->
Review: clean (read-only review on head 3386184; not built here).

- The diff changes two files only: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_projects.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/machines_pane.rs`. The two files are in the `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` tree. No example, golden or shipped source file changes. The diff has 0 CR.
- `same_warning` normalises only one pair: a saved `FirstTraverseLow` with `tilted: false` and a regenerated `FirstTraverseLow` with `tilted: true`. The pair must have the same `at`, the same `fixture` and the same raise (`top_mm - height_mm`, to 1e-6). All other pairs use `saved == regenerated`. The path asserts do not change.
- The negative pin `a_legacy_first_traverse_warning_matches_only_the_same_raise` checks that these do not match: a different raise, a fixture top, an upright warning with other heights, and a different move (`at: 1`). It also checks the positive case and an exact copy.
- `machines_pane.rs`: the test asserts that the 770M row exists before `scroll_to_me()` and the click. The test still checks "Rigid tapping" and "no - tap cycles are refused".
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` is added outside test code. No assert is weaker, except the absolute heights that #3080 moved to the user frame on purpose.
- The causes in the body agree with the code: `crates/sim/src/verify/first_traverse.rs` has the `tilted` field and the old-cache test, and #3204 added a machine row.

Note (not a blocker): the `at: 1` assert in the negative pin has no message. The other asserts have one.

Merge: the coordinator merges head 338618477. Review: the Opus read-only review on this head (comment 7068601171, clean). Gate: the author's runs on this head (both pinned tests and the negative pin, the whole camcraft-ui lib 1387 passed, clippy -p camcraft-ui clean). Test files only; no process file. It fixes the red main of #3233.
